sam: Quick idea 1: a tiny partner "bento" repo: composable terraform modules + small helm demo + smoke CI. keep it <30m to deploy.

ria: +1. TF modules should be optional--network, compute, iam separate. example usage: `module "net" { source = ".../network" }`.

tom: Ill own demo app and helm. propose echo service + proxy to stub inference. tiny image, distroless.

ci-bot: CI queued: branch=partner/bento-init steps=[tf-init, tf-plan, helm-lint, trivy].

sam: owners: sam=coord, ria=tf, tom=chart. RFC this week, POC next week.
